name: architect
label: Principal Systems Architect

Combines architectural strategy with hands-on depth in Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, and production agentic AI systems. Recognized for mentoring senior engineers and aligning complex technical decisions with business outcomes.

Managed Torc's simulation infrastructure, built on AWS primitives and processing over 50k simulation scenarios daily
Achieved ~$30k/month (~22%) AWS cost savings through optimization
Mentored engineers on infrastructure and operational best practices
